correctness.rationale: Explicit contour maps Phi_0 and Phi_1 are continuous homeomorphisms from c>0,t∈R onto plane minus fixed ray R={(u,u):u>=0}. Matching branches at t=1,2 (b0) and t=1,2,3 (b1) give exhaustive foliation by level sets c_0=max{|x-y|,-x-y}, c_1=max{|x-y|,-x,-y}. Direct substitution in every time interval verifies F_b Phi_b(c,t)=Phi_b(c,t+1) even at seams. Each piece has oriented Jacobian c giving d(c²/2) wedge dt. The outgoing/incoming formulas give two-sided positive-elapsed-time drift (c,c) and exact threshold N_b=max(0,ceil(3+b-t)). Independent Fraction computations checked 402 chart/time/height cases across b=0,1 and 3 c values, including 7 translated integer times per sample. Analytic branch checking, not finite testing, proves all-real result.
